label: GO step after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at GO (never at D1 or D2) and almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (99.7% of activation mass has prev_reward == 0; it never fires when the reward input or an action/state input is on). This acts as a necessary condition: it fires on only about 39% of post-loss GO steps, so precision is low (0.39) while recall is 0.95. Adding conditions did not pull out a clean subset. Restricting to prev_common == 1 (common, unrewarded) raises precision to 0.54 but drops mass recall to 0.65. Neither the previous action (a2 is about 1.3x), the upcoming choice, the hidden good state, a run of losses, nor value > 7.5 separates the active steps. Firing is enriched when the policy logit is confident (|choice| > 4.4) and value is high (7.7 to 8.1), and is depleted in the last 20 trials of an episode. Activation magnitude is small (max 0.009) and was not checked further. Likely it carries a graded loss-related signal at GO, with the threshold set inside that distribution.
